messages:
sara: Heads-up nightly NetSuite sync failed for ~47 invoices due to memo overflow from Stripe metadata.

sara: Log excerpt:
```
NetSuite::RecordError: memo length 387 > 255 for invoice inv_02Kzzz
```

sara: The pipeline wrote staging CSVs to s3://redwood-billing/staging/2026-03-23/. I stopped the import to avoid partial postings.

aj: Are these tied to the pricing-experiment cohort blobs again?

sara: Yep. We include full experiment metadata in the invoice memo field. Long proration and coupon details push it over.

miguel: Quick fix idea: truncate memo at 240 chars and append `... (trunc, id=inv_02Kzzz, s3=audit/INV.json)`. Also write the original full metadata to an audit bucket.

ops-jen: @billing-bot please open FIN-4720 and assign to eng for the transform fix and audit retention rules.

billing-bot: Created FIN-4720: "Truncate NS memo + audit blob for Stripe metadata" assigned to @miguel, P2. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4720

miguel: Plan in PR: wrap transform with safe_truncate(memo, 240, marker). Save original payload to s3://redwood-billing/audit/invoices/{invoice_id}.json with 60d lifecycle. Add unit test for 255 boundary. ETA: today EOD.

aj: Please ensure the marker includes original_len and s3_key. That saved us debugging last time.

miguel: ack. marker format: `... (trunc, orig_len=387, s3=audit/invoices/inv_02Kzzz.json)`.

sara: Backfill status: 12 succeeded, 35 blocked. I'll hold remaining replays until the patch is live.

ops-jen: SRE note: when retries happened earlier it caused a flurry of DLQ entries. Not an outage but left some noisy alerts. Disable auto-retry until we patch.

miguel: Disabling retries in config now and kicking a staging import with synthesized long memos. Will comment PR with results.

sara: Once backfill completes, finance needs a CSV of affected invoices for month-end. @miguel can you add an export step?

miguel: Yes, will generate `finance_backfill_report_{date}.csv` and attach to FIN-4720.

billing-bot: FIN-4720 updated: PR link https://git.redwood.ai/billing/commit/def456, staging import queued.

sara: Thanks all. Please CC me on FIN-4720 updates and confirm audit bucket ACLs limited to finance+eng. :thumbsup:
